about.title: Meet Cody Jepson
paragraphs: Jepson Arbor Specialists is Cody Jepson's company. Cody is a certified arborist with 28 years in tree care.
Our goal is simple: quality, high-end arborist services without the high-end price, for homeowners and HOAs across the greater Portland area.
Many of our customers have us back year after year to check on the health of their trees, and we'll always give you the facts without pressure.

estimate.title: Tell us about your trees.
estimate.text: Send us a few details and Cody will get back to you to set up a visit.
estimate.details_label: What would you like looked at?
estimate.thanks: We got your request. Cody will reach out soon to set up a visit.

services.name: Tree Health Assessments
services.blurb: A certified arborist's honest look at the health of your trees.
services.intro: Not sure if a tree is healthy, declining or a risk? Cody will look it over and give you clear facts and options.

services.name: Pruning
services.blurb: Careful pruning that keeps mature trees healthy and beautiful.
services.intro: Mature trees are worth protecting. We prune for structure, health and clearance without over-cutting.

services.name: Cabling & Bracing
services.blurb: Support for large, heavy limbs and split trunks.
services.intro: Cabling and bracing can help support a valuable tree with heavy limbs or weak unions, so you can keep it longer.
includes: Support for mature oaks and maples

services.name: Tree Removal
services.blurb: Careful removal of dead, diseased and hazardous trees.
services.intro: When a tree can't be saved, we remove it carefully and protect the landscape around it.
